data.action: 优雅侧身摆出古典细剑击剑架势，身后巨大影蛾金翼展开，剑尖凝聚星烛
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 微光照彻长夜的剑芒】昏暗沉寂的战场中央，薇薇安娜摆出高雅古典的击剑架势。金色细剑的尖端凝聚起一团璀璨如星辰的烛光，巨大的影蛾光翼在她身后展开，将周围的阴影与黑暗尽数驱散——「即使微光渺小……我也绝不会背弃我的誓言。」
data.lighting: 细剑尖端凝聚的耀眼星烛金光与身后影蛾光芒
data.promptProse: Viviana holds a classical fencing stance on a silent nighttime battlefield, golden candlelight gathering at her rapier tip. Huge luminous shadow-moth wings unfold behind her armored figure. The dynamic cowboy view brings the sword point across the foreground, with broken earth extending beyond her shoulders. Its glow brightens her white glove and antlers, while the wings separate her black armor from the surrounding gloom.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 微光照彻长夜的剑芒
